description: Read and change a Datadog organization — 13 monitors, 6 dashboards, 5 slos, 1 logs, 4 apm, 9 metrics, 6 infrastructure, 3 services, 6 notebooks, 5 synthetics, 4 downtimes, 3 users, 2 rum, 2 incidents, 1 teams, 1 security, 4 admin — in your current app.datadoghq.com tab (monitors, dashboards, SLOs, logs, APM, metrics, infrastructure, services, notebooks, synthetics, downtimes, users, RUM, incidents, teams, security signals and admin settings). Uses your own logged-in Datadog session: same-origin /api/... calls with the dd-csrf-token the app keeps in localStorage.

tools.name: list_monitors
tools.description: List monitors in the Datadog organization. Supports filtering by tags and pagination. Returns monitor details including name, type, query, state, and tags.

tools.name: get_monitor
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Datadog monitor by its ID.

tools.name: search_monitors
tools.description: Search for monitors by query string. Supports searching by name, status, tags, and other attributes. Use Datadog monitor search syntax (e.g., "status:Alert", "tag:env:prod", "type:metric").

tools.name: mute_monitor
tools.description: Mute a monitor so it does not trigger alerts. Optionally specify a scope and end time.

tools.name: unmute_monitor
tools.description: Unmute a previously muted monitor so it resumes alerting.

tools.name: delete_monitor
tools.description: Permanently delete a monitor. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_monitor_tags
tools.description: List all tags used across monitors. Useful for discovering available filter values.

tools.name: get_monitor_groups
tools.description: Get the status of individual groups for a multi-alert monitor. Useful for seeing which specific hosts, services, or tag combinations are alerting.

tools.name: get_monitor_state_history
tools.description: Preview the evaluation results of a monitor over a time range. Shows the timeseries data that the monitor evaluates against.

tools.name: create_monitor
tools.description: Create a new Datadog monitor. Supports metric, service check, event, log, process, synthetics, and other monitor types.

tools.name: update_monitor
tools.description: Update an existing Datadog monitor. Only specified fields are changed.

tools.name: list_monitor_downtimes
tools.description: Get downtimes associated with a specific monitor.

tools.name: clone_monitor
tools.description: Clone an existing monitor to create a copy. Optionally override the name, query, message, or tags on the clone. The original monitor is not modified.

tools.name: list_dashboards
tools.description: List all dashboards in the Datadog organization. Returns dashboard summaries with titles, authors, and URLs.

tools.name: get_dashboard
tools.description: Get full details of a Datadog dashboard by ID, including its widgets, layout, and template variables.

tools.name: search_dashboards
tools.description: Search dashboards by title or description. Performs a client-side substring match across all dashboards.

tools.name: search_dashboards_advanced
tools.description: Search dashboards with advanced filters including author handle. Performs client-side filtering across all dashboards.

tools.name: delete_dashboard
tools.description: Permanently delete a Datadog dashboard. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: clone_dashboard
tools.description: Clone an existing dashboard to create a copy. Optionally override the title or description. The original dashboard is not modified.

tools.name: list_slos
tools.description: List Service Level Objectives (SLOs) in the Datadog organization with optional tag filtering.

tools.name: get_slo
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific Service Level Objective (SLO) by ID.

tools.name: get_slo_history
tools.description: Get historical SLO data for a specific timeframe. Returns SLI values, error budget remaining, and uptime data.

tools.name: search_slos
tools.description: Search SLOs by name using substring matching.

tools.name: list_slo_corrections
tools.description: List all SLO status corrections in the Datadog organization.

tools.name: search_logs
tools.description: Search Datadog logs using query syntax. Supports filtering by service, host, status, tags, and free text. Uses the Datadog log query language (e.g., "service:my-app status:error", "@http.status_code:500").

tools.name: search_spans
tools.description: Search APM spans/traces using Datadog query syntax. Filter by service, resource, operation, status, duration, and tags (e.g., "service:web-store", "@http.status_code:500", "@duration:>5000000").

tools.name: get_trace
tools.description: Get a full trace by trace ID from Datadog APM. Accepts either hex or decimal trace IDs. Returns all spans within the trace, including orphaned spans.

tools.name: aggregate_spans
tools.description: Aggregate Datadog APM spans to compute counts, sums, averages, min, max, and cardinality, with optional grouping by fields or time intervals. Use this for aggregated analysis such as request counts over time, average duration by service, or error counts grouped by endpoint.

tools.name: get_service_dependencies
tools.description: Get upstream and downstream service dependencies for an APM service. Returns services that call this service and services this service calls.

tools.name: query_metrics
tools.description: Query time-series metric data from Datadog. Use standard metric query syntax with aggregation, scope, and optional group-by (e.g., "avg:system.cpu.user{env:prod} by {host}").

tools.name: list_metrics
tools.description: List metric names available in Datadog. Filter by prefix to narrow results.

tools.name: get_metric_metadata
tools.description: Get metadata for a specific metric including type, description, unit, and integration name.

tools.name: query_timeseries
tools.description: Execute a multi-query timeseries request using the Datadog internal query engine. Supports metrics, logs, spans, and other data sources with formula support.

tools.name: list_metric_tags
tools.description: List all tags associated with a specific metric. Useful for understanding available dimensions for filtering and grouping.

tools.name: get_metric_tag_configuration
tools.description: Get the Metrics without Limits tag configuration for a metric, including its indexed or excluded tag keys, metric type, aggregation settings, and timestamps.

tools.name: create_metric_tag_configuration
tools.description: Create a Metrics without Limits tag configuration for a metric that does not already have one. Returns the saved metric type, indexed or excluded tag keys, percentile setting, and timestamps.

tools.name: update_metric_tag_configuration
tools.description: Update an existing Metrics without Limits tag configuration. Change any combination of tag keys, exclusion mode, or distribution percentiles. Returns the saved configuration.

tools.name: delete_metric_tag_configuration
tools.description: Delete a Metrics without Limits tag configuration. The metric continues to exist, but Datadog resumes indexing all submitted tags for it.

tools.name: list_hosts
tools.description: List infrastructure hosts reporting to Datadog. Supports filtering by name and pagination.

tools.name: mute_host
tools.description: Mute a host to suppress all monitor alerts originating from it.

tools.name: unmute_host
tools.description: Unmute a previously muted host to resume alerting.

tools.name: get_host_totals
tools.description: Get the total number of active and up hosts in the organization.

tools.name: list_host_tags
tools.description: List all tags for a specific host, organized by source (e.g., datadog-agent, cloud provider).

tools.name: get_host_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific host by hostname.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List service definitions from the Datadog service catalog. Returns service names, owning teams, contacts, and links.

tools.name: get_service_definition
tools.description: Get the full service catalog definition for a specific service, including team, contacts, links, and tags.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search services in the service catalog by name, team, or other attributes.

tools.name: list_notebooks
tools.description: List Datadog notebooks with optional text search. Notebooks are collaborative documents with time-synced data widgets.

tools.name: get_notebook
tools.description: Get full details of a Datadog notebook by ID, including its cells and metadata.

tools.name: search_notebooks
tools.description: Search Datadog notebooks by name. Returns matching notebooks sorted by modification time.

tools.name: create_notebook
tools.description: Create a new Datadog notebook with markdown and metric cells.

tools.name: update_notebook
tools.description: Update an existing Datadog notebook — change name, cells, or time span.

tools.name: delete_notebook
tools.description: Permanently delete a Datadog notebook. This action cannot be undone.

tools.name: list_synthetics_tests
tools.description: List synthetic monitoring tests (API, browser, mobile). Supports filtering by page size.

tools.name: get_synthetics_test
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific synthetic test by public ID.

tools.name: get_synthetics_results
tools.description: Get recent execution results for a synthetic test.

tools.name: trigger_synthetics_test
tools.description: Trigger an on-demand run of a synthetic test. Returns the triggered results with batch ID.

tools.name: pause_synthetics_test
tools.description: Pause or resume a synthetic test by changing its status.

tools.name: list_downtimes
tools.description: List scheduled downtimes (maintenance windows) in the Datadog organization.

tools.name: get_downtime
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific scheduled downtime by ID.

tools.name: cancel_downtime
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled downtime by ID. This resumes alerting for the affected monitors.

tools.name: create_downtime
tools.description: Create a scheduled downtime (maintenance window) in Datadog.

tools.name: get_current_user
tools.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated Datadog user.

tools.name: list_users
tools.description: List users in the Datadog organization. Supports filtering and pagination.

tools.name: get_user
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific user by UUID.

tools.name: search_rum_events
tools.description: Search Real User Monitoring (RUM) events. Filter by event type, user, URL, browser, and more using Datadog query syntax (e.g., "@type:error", "@view.url:*/checkout/*", "@usr.id:user123").

tools.name: aggregate_rum_events
tools.description: Aggregate Datadog RUM events to compute counts, sums, averages, min, max, and cardinality, with optional grouping by fields or time intervals. Use this for aggregated analysis of RUM data such as session counts over time, error counts by page, or average loading times by browser.

tools.name: list_incidents
tools.description: List incidents in the Datadog organization. Supports filtering by status and pagination. Note: Incident Management must be enabled.

tools.name: get_incident
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific incident by ID.

tools.name: list_teams
tools.description: List teams in the Datadog organization.

tools.name: search_security_signals
tools.description: Search security signals in Datadog Security Monitoring.

tools.name: get_permissions
tools.description: List all available permissions in the Datadog organization. Useful for understanding role-based access.

tools.name: get_org_config
tools.description: Get a specific organization configuration value by name.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: List API keys in the Datadog organization.

tools.name: get_usage_summary
tools.description: Get usage summary for the Datadog organization over a time range.
